info.name: HustleHub_Part2
info.description:
HustleHub+ Part 2 — full-stack API tests covering authentication, RBAC, gig CRUD, bookings/transactions, earnings, and security controls (NoSQL injection, validation, Helmet headers).

Run order matters: requests are numbered and use collection variables chained via test scripts.

Newman (self-signed cert): newman run HustleHub_Part2.postman_collection.json --insecure
